title: Direct summands of perfect complexes are perfect
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let K and L be objects of the derived category D(\mathcal{O}_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. If K is isomorphic to a direct sum L \oplus M for some object M and K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then L is perfect (and likewise M is perfect).
